reviewNotes: Twenty-five ore-collection and Slime-hunting quest strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, quality-fragment agreement, exact dialogue and newline markers, dynamic resource grammar, monster terminology, repaired plural suffixes, leading and trailing spaces, punctuation, and character voice; both found no remaining objective issue.

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13662.source: You brought the ores I requested!

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13667.source: #$b#I like to inspect local ores from time to time, to keep track of quality and abundance.#$b#Let me just take a look at these... Hmm... I see.#$b#Thank you. You can keep these ores. They're of {0} quality.
ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13667.translation: #$b#Îmi place să inspectez din când în când minereurile locale, ca să le urmăresc calitatea și abundența.#$b#Să le arunc o privire... Hmm... Înțeleg.#$b#Mulțumesc. Poți păstra minereurile. Au o calitate {0}.

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13672.source: #$b#These ores look to be of good quality... You can keep them, of course. I just wanted to see how the local geology is doing.
ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13672.translation: #$b#Minereurile acestea par de bună calitate... Le poți păstra, desigur. Voiam doar să văd care este starea geologiei locale.

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13673.translation: #$b#...Iar aici este plata, așa cum am promis.

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13674.source: Hello! It's Robin. Could someone bring me {0} pieces of {1}? They need to be fresh... that means gathered today. Thanks!
ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13674.translation: Bună! Sunt Robin. Poate cineva să-mi aducă {0} bucăți de {1}? Trebuie să fie proaspete... adică strânse astăzi. Mulțumesc!

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13677.source: Hey, looks like you got the {0} I asked for.
ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13677.translation: Hei, se pare că ai adus cantitatea de {0} pe care am cerut-o.

ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13688.source: - You can keep the ores after Clint inspects them.
ResourceCollectionQuest.cs.13688.translation: - Poți păstra minereurile după ce le inspectează Clint.

SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13711.source: The monsters known as 'Duggies' are making a mess of the local mine! The holes they create could weaken the structural integrity of the mines. Could someone defeat {0} of these creatures?
SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13711.translation: Monștrii numiți Duggy fac prăpăd în mina locală! Găurile pe care le sapă ar putea slăbi integritatea structurală a minelor. Poate cineva să învingă {0} dintre aceste creaturi?

SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13723.translation: Se caută: vânător de Slime care să ucidă {0} {1}

SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13725.source: Frost Jellies in the frozen depths of the mine.
SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13725.translation: Gelatine de Gheață în adâncurile înghețate ale minei.

SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13727.source: Red Slimes in the deep lava caverns of the local mine.
SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13727.translation: Slime Roșii în cavernele adânci de lavă ale minei locale.

SlayMonsterQuest.cs.13728.source: Green Slimes in the local mine.
